messages:
nina: Heads-up: per-token card on the console is showing implausible negative cache savings after we enabled phase-aware routing rollouts. Tenant 'atlas-ai' flagged by the sentinel.
arpit: Do we still aggregate by (tenant, model) only? that collapses prefetch credits with hotpath cost.
mason: We do. Current rollup SQL: 
```
SELECT tenant, model, SUM(token_cost) cost, SUM(prefetch_credit) credits
FROM econ_invocations
WHERE day='2026-03-22' AND sample=true
GROUP BY tenant, model
```
That loses route_phase and doesn't scale sampled rows.
nina: Right. Also frontend applies a routing-adjustment factor post-rollup for canary/fallback accounting. If ETL later scales + adjusts, we end up double-adjusting.
arpit: Quick mitigation: add a confidence pill on the card ("Estimated — 10% sample") and hide sparklines when daily_invocations < 40. That should cut support noise.
yvonne: For the fix I propose: ETL emits fields scaled_token_cost, scaled_prefetch_credit, sample_rate, route_phase, and an event_provenance tag. Frontend will consume scaled_* directly and stop applying multipliers.
mason: Also add an enum credit_source {prefetch, hotpath, fallback} and preserve it in the rollup. That allows the console to show a small 3-row breakdown when users expand the card.
ops-bot: Created ticket ECO-900. PRs: ETL-1200, UI-1201, TEST-1202. Added 48h post-deploy watch in the runbook.
arpit: I'll own the ETL change. plan: change nightly job to emit scaled columns and a sample_count, and add tests for sample_rate=0.05 small-tenant edgecases.
nina: I'll update the card to display "scaled" numbers and a toggle to view raw events for debugging. also add tooltip copy: "Numbers estimated from sampled events; use breakdown for per-phase detail."
yvonne: Quick nits for UX copy — use "Estimated (10% sample) ±20%" and for the breakdown button label use "Inspect by phase".
mason: we should also add a compatibility shim for existing exports that expect tenant+model keys; add export_collapsed=true to flatten phase dimension.
arpit: timeline: ETL + tests in 2 days; UI patch in 1 day. aiming to deploy Friday night in low-traffic window.
ops-bot: Alert rule econ-sample-phase-mismatch created (threshold: >4 tenants negative savings) with 2h cooldown.
nina: thanks. please ping #eng-oncall if sentinel fires after rollout. will follow up with a short postmortem if needed.
